pages.title: Our Values - Globeducate
blocks: Globeducate is a dynamic, progressive global education group developing young people and the minds of tomorrow – those who we will prepare to be global citizens who can shape the world. We are forward-looking and innovative as a group and we strive towards educational excellence from the youngest children to our graduating year groups.

Our approach to building teams is careful and intuitive. We know how crucial our teachers and support staff are not only in inspiring and developing our students but also in building confidence and a love of learning in our teams as well.

We are proud of our global culture which resonates with our key principles. We know that the framework of a culture lies in its core mission and values – it also relies on people to bring these values to life. That is why we also have People Values, which you can find below.
As a company, our values are:

In order to bring these key principles to life, we strive for our people – whether they are teachers, IT technicians, accountancy teams, teaching assistants or school nurses – to strive Be excellent, Be Supportive, Be a Pioneer and to Be Global.
Be excellent: We do challenging work and achieve incredible things. Excellence is one of our core values.
Be supportive: We support each other as we grow. Globeducate values a culture of discipline, teamwork, respect, perseverance and determination.
Be a pioneer: We innovate and push for boundless creativity, through proactivity, responsibility and passion.
Be global: We know no bounds to shape the world. We embrace different cultures through diversity and inclusion.

pages.title: Our Schools - Globeducate - International Schools | Shaping the world
blocks: Situated in La Massana in the northeast of the Principality of Andorra on the site of the Aldosa sports centre, Agora Andorra International School was founded in 1999 as Collegi del Pirineu and now offers a bilingual IB education in Spanish and English. It is the ideal location to combine academic study with sport.

Agora Barcelona International School is located in Sant Esteve Sesrovires, 25 kilometers from Barcelona. It was founded in 2008 and offers both the Spanish Baccalaureate and, since 2017, the International Baccalaureate Diploma. With great sports facilities, offers vocational training programmes in Sport and Leisure.

Agora Granada College International School is a private bi-lingual school for infants through to sixth form, renowned for its academic standards and its dynamic sports programme. The curriculum is taught through English and Spanish by native and bi-lingual teachers.

Agora Lledó International School was founded in 2001 in Castellon. It was the very first Globeducate to offer the International Baccalaureate Diploma and, since 2017, it has also offered the International Primary Curriculum (IPC). The school has excellent sports facilities and is an officially recognised music school.

Agora Madrid International School in Villaviciosa de Odón is an English/Spanish bilingual school founded in 1981. It has extensive facilities near the capital and offers the International Baccalaureate Diploma and excellent co-curricular programmes in music, dance, theatre and the arts.

Agora Portals is situated in the municipality of Calvià in Portals Nous, just 10 kilometres away from Majorca’s capital city, Palma. It was founded in 2008 and is the first school in the region to offer the International Baccalaureate Diploma. Agora Portals also has an Integrated Music School.

Agora Princess Margaret International School is located in the vibrant city of Barcelona, within the district of Horta-Guinardo. Just a 20-minutes commute from the city centre, this district presents a perfect blend of urban convenience and natural surroundings, and has excellent connections and transports options.

Located on the outskirts of Barcelona, Agora Sant Cugat International School is where the Globeducate groups was born. With over 1500 students aged between 0 and 20, Agora Sant Cugat offers a variety of national and international qualifications as well as vocational training in Image and Sound.
BAPS-The British American Pre-School and BES-The Bilingual European School

British American Pre-School (BAPS) and Bilingual European School (BES) in Milan offer bilingual English-Italian education, IB, PYP, MYP (Candidate School) and Dual Diploma Italian Ministerial programme-Ontario Secondary School Diploma and innovative learning spaces for students aged two to 18.

Blyth Academy is a co-educational private school with multiple campuses across Ontario, and offers a comprehensive full-time programme, as well as online, part-time, private, summer school programmes.

Boundary Oak School takes pride in its strong family ethos and the personalised learning it provides. This is a community of learning built upon mutual trust and respect between teachers and pupils with a strong, shared sense of purpose and a commitment to high standards driven by enthusiasm.

Cambridge House British International School in Valencia is a highly distinguished British international school, with 1,700 students. It was the first in Spain to gain joint BSO (British School Overseas) and NABSS (National Association for British Schools in Spain) accreditation.

Canadian School of Florence is a co-ed private school that follows the Canadian Ontario Curriculum and hosts a unique mix of international students and local Italian students. Canadian School of Florence opened its first campus in Florence in 2017.

Founded in 1951 in Santiago de Compostela, Colegio Peleteiro is a leading school in Galicia, recognised for academic excellence and a strong commitment to student development. The school promotes curiosity, critical thinking, and meaningful learning in a positive environment rooted in strong values.

Coruña British International School is located in A Coruña and was founded in 2015 as a sister school to the O Castro British International School in northern Galicia. The school currently offers courses for Early Years and Primary school children and follows the National Curriculum for England. It has been part of Globeducate since 2017.

Known for its explicit, traditional teaching methods and strong focus on core subjects, especially French, Cours Sainte-Anne offers programs from Kindergarten to lower secondary (4ème). Its main strength lies in its highly personalized approach, tailored to each student’s individual needs.

École Trilingue Internationale welcomes students from kindergarten to high school right in the heart of Casablanca. The school offers trilingual teaching (French, English, Arabic) from pre-school, inspired by the best international pedagogical practices while respecting the Moroccan referential framework.

The Educational Group OLYMPION, established in 2003, is a distinguished educational institution in Cyprus that emphasises a holistic, student-centred approach. OLYMPION offers a comprehensive educational program, aiming to nurture the intellectual, artistic, and physical development of its students.

EIB de la Jonchère is located in Bougival, Paris, and is the most recent primary level addition to the EIB family. Opened in September 2017 as part of the Globeducate Group, the school offers a bilingual education, delivering the French national curriculum in both French and English.

EIB Grenelle is located at the heart of Paris, near the Eiffel Tower. Open since September 2021 as part of Globeducate. The school offers a bilingual education to children from Nursery to Grade 5, delivering the French national curriculum in both French and English.

Lycée EIB Etoile is located in the XVIIth district of Paris and educates EIB Paris’s senior students aged from 15 to 18. The school teaches the French national curriculum with a large percentage of classes taught in English. Students work towards the French national or International Baccalaureates.

EIB Paris College Monceau is EIB’s Secondary School in Paris. Created in 1954 and located in the XVIIth district, the college welcomes students from all over the world. The school delivers the French national curriculum, with a large percentage of classes taught in English. It joined Globeducate in 2011.

EIB Lamartine and EIB Monceau are the two EIB primary schools in Paris. The school was founded in 1954 and is located in the XVIth district. The school welcomes students from 3 to 10 years old and teaches the French national curriculum. EIB Lamartine joined Globeducate in 2011.

EIB Monceau is one of two EIB primary schools in Paris. It was founded in 1954 in a typically grand Paris residence in the 8th district (famous for the Avenue des Champs Elysées), welcomes students from 3 to 11 years old and offers the French national curriculum, with a large number of classes taught in […]

EIB Trocadéro is located in the heart of Paris, near Trocadéro. Set to open in September 2025, the school will provide a bilingual education to children from Nursery through Grade 5, offering the French national curriculum in both French and English.

Located in the heart of Paris' 17th arrondissement, EIB Wagram is a new bilingual primary school opening in September 2026. Welcoming children from Nursery to Year 6 (Petite Section to CM2), the school combines the French National Curriculum with an equal French-English bilingual programme, providing a warm, ambitious and internationally minded learning environment.

EIB à distance offers French academic programs aligned with the French National Education curriculum, from Kindergarten to High School. Families can choose full-time schooling or individual subject courses, tailored specifically for French families living in France or abroad. The school also offers a wide range of options for enhanced language learning, with a particular focus on English.

English Gate School is located in a beautiful green area near Como. Monza is less than 30 minutes from the school and Milan can be easily reached by public transport. The school caters for children from age one to 14 and provides its students with a unique learning experience focused not only on academic success but also the holistic growth of each child, aiming to help each individual find their strengths and reach their full potential.

ICS Côte d’Azur is the only bilingual school in the Riviera Region offering the IB Primary Years Programme in French and English. A team of internationally-minded teaching staff puts every student at the centre of their learning journey, creating an unparalleled culture of care.

ICS London was founded in central London in 1979 and today welcomes students of more than 65 different nationalities. The school offers the prestigious International Baccalaureate programme at every educational stage, as well as the IGCSE programme for students in Year 10 and Year 11. ICS London provides support in English as an Additional Language (EAL).

ICS Milan was founded in 2017 following a merger of the KC Infant and Primary schools with the Ludum Design School. Both of these projects were founded in 2009. The school offers a cosmopolitan education.

ICS Paris welcomes students in an inspiring, warm and inclusive environment. A member of ICS, a leading International Baccalaureate School Group in Europe - ICS Paris fosters all the values at the heart of an IB education from primary to high school leading our students, of more than 70 nationalities, towards the IB Diploma.

The International French School of Amsterdam offers a bilingual French-English curriculum regulated by the French National Education Programme which provides daily immersion in two languages and cultures from the earliest age possible, in a beautiful school right in the heart of Amsterdam.

The International School of Paphos (ISOP), established in 1987 as the first private English school in Paphos, is a leading educational institution in Cyprus, providing high-quality education to nearly 1,200 students aged 2½ to 18 years. The school follows an enriched English National Curriculum, complemented by an emphasis on Greek language and culture. As an accredited centre for Cambridge International Education (CIE) and Pearson Edexcel, ISOP enables students to achieve excellent examination results and secure placements at prestigious universities worldwide.

IPS British International School, Cascais is a leading British International School delivering the National Curriculum for England, in Cascais, near Lisbon. The school accepts children aged 3 to 16, with the school introducing secondary aged students from September 2022. The school has approximately 400 children from around 40 countries around the globe.

ISN Nice has been a leading light in international education on the French Riviera for more than 40 years. From Early Years to High School, students benefit from a future-proof education with a holistic approach, designed to prepare them for university and beyond.

L'Ecole de Battersea is an “Outstanding” Ofsted rated bilingual school following the French national curriculum , combined with elements of the National Curriculum for England. Children aged three to 11 attend the AEFE-accredited school opened in 2005 and caters for up to 280 children.

L'Ecole des Petits (Fulham) has been a leading light in French-English pre-primary education since 1977 and is an “Outstanding” Ofsted rated bilingual school, AEFE accredited, following the French curriculum with elements of the National Curriculum for England. The school caters for 120 students.

Learnissimo is a video-conference platform which provides one-to-one lessons in 12 languages with native and graduate teachers. Most of our business is with corporate partners who generally need to complete their face-to-face programmes with our platform.

Lycée Français Guy de Maupassant is ideally located on an outstanding and modern campus in Casablanca. The school welcomes students from pre-school to high school, offers trilingual teaching (French, Arabic, English) and delivers the French National Curriculum.

Lycée Français Sophie Germain is located in the heart of Rabat's Hay Riad district. The school is on a human scale, with modern facilities, offers trilingual teaching (French, English, Arabic) from the very earliest age, delivers a French baccalaureate and places children's wellbeing at the heart of its pedagogical project.

Located on the French Riviera, in the heart of Nice Sophia-Antipolis, Mougins British International School offers the world leading British school programme for students aged three to 18, within an international context. Mougins School prepares students academically to meet the challenges of tomorrow, whilst also developing vital life skills through sport, art, music and drama.
Nobel Algarve British International School, Almancil

A purpose-built, state-of-the-art campus that caters for pupils from Pre-School through to Year 7, and, as of September 2022, up to Year 9. From 2023 the school will welcome pupils up to Year 10, to cover full middle school education. Located in the heart of the Algarve’s prestigious ‘Golden Triangle’, students benefit from all the traditions and heritage of a British-style education.
Nobel Algarve British International School, Lagoa

Nobel Algarve British International School’s flagship campus educates 1,000+ students from more than 43 nationalities, aged three to 18. It offers the English National Curriculum as well as a Portuguese National section that follows the official Portuguese Ministry of Education programme. Every year students from Nobel Algarve British International School go on to study at the most prestigious universities across Europe and globally.

Founded in 2008 as the first British School in Galicia, O Castro British International School is located in the town of Mos in the district of Vigo and has been part of the Globeducate Group since 2017. O Castro British International School believes that the learning experience should be positive, inspiring and fun.

Students at PASCAL Education Larnaka benefit from studying on a modern, purpose-built campus in an area of 60,000 sqm in Aradippou. The school offers 35 classrooms, specialist computer and science labs, art rooms and a library with more than 10,000 volumes
The modern, purpose-built LEFKOSIA campus of PASCAL Education was founded in 1988 and offers an English National Curriculum Pre-School and Primary education through to the IBDP two-year programme.

Founded 2002, this campus is located in the Lemesos Municipality areas and is temporarily situated in a premises with 2,500 sqm, offering 15 classrooms, two computer labs, specialist science labs, library, art room and canteen.
Queen Morta School is a Lithuanian private school in Vilnius and Kaunas, educating more than 1,000 students. It is the first and only IB Continuum School in Vilnius and Kaunas.

RIS Rome offers an international English-centred education for children aged from 2 to 18. Students of more than 45 different nationalities attend the school. The school offers the International Baccalaureate programme from Primary (EYP) to pre-university level (IB Diploma).

St George’s British International School is situated in the busy town of Leioa in the district of Bilbao. With a history dating back to 1956, it is a bilingual school that has developed an outstanding reputation throughout the Basque region. St George’s British International School joined Globeducate in 2017.

Stonar is a British day and boarding school founded in 1895 and situated in the county of Wiltshire, close to the historic city of Bath. The school has an international boarding house that welcomes students from all over the world. The school has magnificent sports facilities and a state-of-the-art equestrian centre.
The Clover School is a CCMA accredited Montessori school with an innovative curriculum designed to meet the needs of contemporary childhood. The school has two campuses in Toronto.

The Indian Public School – Bengaluru is situated in the northern part of the city in the south of India, and is a co-educational private day and boarding school that prepares students for lifelong learning and a future in a constantly changing world. This new campus is the latest addition to TIPS.

Located in the city of Chennai on India’s southeastern coast, TIPS Chennai is a co-educational international school that works to inspire the leaders of the future. Since 2011 TIPS Chennai’s senior students have had the opportunity to study for the world-renowned International Baccalaureate Diploma.

Located in the city of Coimbatore in southern India, TIPS Coimbatore is a private co-educational international school that offers boarding facilities. The school encourages its students to think creatively and independently and their learning is guided by highly-qualified teaching professionals.

TIPS Hyderabad has three modern campuses catering to students from KG to A Level. We offer CBSE curriculum and highly respected international programmes such as IB, IGCSE and A-Levels. The campus consists of modern classrooms, a robotics lab and space and rocketry lab.

Located in Karur in southern India, TIPS Karur is a private co-educational international school delivering the IGCSE and IB programmes. The school fosters creative thinking and encourages its students to become self-motivated, responsible and independent learners.

TIPS Kochi is a private, co-educational, international school that fosters active and independent learning, creative thinking and the pursuit of academic excellence. TIPS Kochi believes strongly in providing a broad and balanced curriculum and offers a wide range of co-curricular and extra-curricular subjects.

TIPS Madurai main campus caters to students from KG to grade 8. We offer CBSE curriculum and International curriculum. The campus consists of modern classrooms and labs with state-of-the-art-technology.

Located in the city of Tirupur in southern India, TIPS Tirupur is a co-educational, private international school, which actively promotes independent learning, creative thinking and academic excellence and offers a complete programme of extra-academic activities.

Toronto Prep School is a co-educational private school in Toronto, Ontario, founded in 2009. Situated on an urban campus in the heart of Toronto near Mount Pleasant Road and Davisville Ave, it caters for students from Grade 7 through to 12.
Vaikystės Sodas is a leading Lithuanian early childhood education network, welcoming more than 700 children aged one to six across 11 kindergartens in Vilnius, Kaunas, Klaipėda and Panevėžys.
TIPS Schools are overseen by the Committee comprising of Mr. Rajeeva Karandikar; Mr. Jairam Balakrishnan; and Mr. Ashok Kumar. Please read more here
